translations.title: Why must AMP motion data and discriminator features still be audited after explicit reference tracking is removed?
translations.answer: AMP learns the supported short state transitions in motion data as a style reward. It removes explicit clip/phase selection but turns foot slip, bad contact, and coverage gaps in the dataset into reward boundaries. Data version, feature map, sample interval, discriminator, and policy must be audited as one unit.

translations.applicability.assumptions.1: The motion dataset has been audited for artifacts and required behavior coverage.

translations.confidence_rationale: The paper's dataset-content experiments and discriminator ablations directly show that learned style follows data and feature design, while pinned code exposes observation, replay, and reward paths. Confidence is capped because style quality is partly distributional/subjective and the evidence is simulation-only.
